title: Wrapped in Waxed Cloth  (裹在蜡布里)

segments.t: 清晨凉爽的空气充满庭院，格雷厄姆稳稳地压下铁撬棍。泰莎端着三杯热气腾腾的咖啡，轻步走出咖啡厅厨房，来到汉娜和格雷厄姆身旁。请先完整听一遍这一幕。
Good morning, treasure hunters! I brought hot coffee before my bread dough rises.
Perfect timing, Tessa — Graham is lifting the third stone right now!
Hold the lantern low, Hannah, while I prop this stone safely on a wooden block.
Oh, look down inside that neat square pocket of clean dry river sand!
Someone lined the sides with four red bricks to keep the winter rain out!
That sounds like smart old engineering — and look what is resting in the middle.
It is a square bundle tied with twine and wrapped in thick yellow waxed cloth!
May I reach down and lift it out, Graham?
Go ahead, Hannah, both hands — tell us if it feels wet or heavy.
It is completely dry, surprisingly light, and something metal just slid inside!
Carry it straight into Room Nine before the upstairs windows open for breakfast!
I will set the flat stone back in place so nobody trips over table one.
现在我们一步步回顾第三块庭院石板下方发现宝藏的那一刻。
Good morning, treasure hunters! I brought hot coffee before my bread dough rises.
“早安，寻宝者们！趁着我的面包面团还没发起来，我端了热咖啡过来。”这句亲切的问候用到了复合名词：
treasure hunters
不及物动词 rise 在这里用来形容面团发酵膨胀：
before my bread dough rises
Perfect timing, Tessa — Graham is lifting the third stone right now!
“来得正是时候，泰莎——格雷厄姆这会儿正在撬起第三块石板呢！”称赞别人来得恰逢其时，常说：
Perfect timing
同时用现在进行时描述眼前正在发生的动作：
Graham is lifting
Hold the lantern low, Hannah, while I prop this stone safely on a wooden block.
“汉娜，把灯笼拎低一点，我把这块石板稳稳支在木块上。”这里的副词 low 表示把灯拿在贴近地面的低处：
Hold the lantern low
动词 prop 意为“用支撑物顶住或垫稳”：
I prop this stone safely
Oh, look down inside that neat square pocket of clean dry river sand!
“哇，快往那个整整齐齐的方形小坑里瞧，里面铺着干净干燥的河沙！”副词 down 连用 inside，把视线引向坑洞内部：
look down inside
这里的 pocket 比喻一个大小合适、规整的小凹坑：
that neat square pocket
Someone lined the sides with four red bricks to keep the winter rain out!
“有人用四块红砖砌好了内壁，免得冬天的雨水渗进来！”动词 line 意为“给孔洞或容器内壁铺衬、砌衬”：
Someone lined the sides
而结构 keep something out 表示“把某物挡在外面，不让进来”：
to keep the winter rain out
That sounds like smart old engineering — and look what is resting in the middle.
“这听起来真是巧妙的老派工程手艺——快看正中间静静躺着什么。”根据眼前所见所闻来评价一个点子，常用：
That sounds like
动词 rest 描绘物件安稳平放的状态：
what is resting in the middle
It is a square bundle tied with twine and wrapped in thick yellow waxed cloth!
“是一个用麻绳捆着、裹在厚实黄色蜡布里的方形包裹！”注意这两个介词的对比：表示用绳子捆绑时用 with，
tied with twine
而表示包裹在布料里面时用 in：
wrapped in thick yellow waxed cloth
May I reach down and lift it out, Graham?
“格雷厄姆，我可以伸手下去把它拿出来吗？”情态动词 may 在此表达礼貌的请求：
May I reach down
搭配短语动词 lift out（“伸手抬出、拿出来”）：
and lift it out
Go ahead, Hannah, both hands — tell us if it feels wet or heavy.
“拿吧，汉娜，用两只手——告诉我们摸起来是湿的还是沉的。”爽快地允许对方动手，常说：
Go ahead, Hannah
系动词 feel 后面直接跟形容词，用来描述触摸时的手感：
if it feels wet or heavy
It is completely dry, surprisingly light, and something metal just slid inside!
“完全是干的，轻得出奇，而且里面刚有什么金属东西滑了一下！”这里用 -ly 副词来修饰形容词：
surprisingly light
形容词性的修饰成分要紧跟在不定代词 something 的后面：
something metal just slid inside
Carry it straight into Room Nine before the upstairs windows open for breakfast!
“趁楼上吃早饭前还没开窗，赶紧把它直接端进九号房里！”副词 straight 放在 into 前面，表示“径直、一刻不停地”：
Carry it straight into Room Nine
趁楼上还没醒来打开：
the upstairs windows
I will set the flat stone back in place so nobody trips over table one.
“我把这块扁石板放回原位，免得谁被一号桌绊倒。”短语 set back in place 意为“把某物原样放回原处”：
set the flat stone back in place
动词 trip 搭配 over 表示“被……绊倒”：
so nobody trips over table one
让我们把整段对话从头到尾再听一遍。
Good morning, treasure hunters! I brought hot coffee before my bread dough rises.
Perfect timing, Tessa — Graham is lifting the third stone right now!
Hold the lantern low, Hannah, while I prop this stone safely on a wooden block.
Oh, look down inside that neat square pocket of clean dry river sand!
Someone lined the sides with four red bricks to keep the winter rain out!
That sounds like smart old engineering — and look what is resting in the middle.
It is a square bundle tied with twine and wrapped in thick yellow waxed cloth!
May I reach down and lift it out, Graham?
Go ahead, Hannah, both hands — tell us if it feels wet or heavy.
It is completely dry, surprisingly light, and something metal just slid inside!
Carry it straight into Room Nine before the upstairs windows open for breakfast!
I will set the flat stone back in place so nobody trips over table one.
四面砖墙、干燥的河沙和厚实的蜡布，将这个三十年前的包裹安然无恙地保存在庭院石板底下。待会儿见！
See you next time!
